errors.evidence: The chart does not include data for Russia. The country code "RO" represents Romania.
The chart shows 27 country codes plus an entry for the EU average, not 28 member states.
The countries on the horizontal axis are not in alphabetical order; they are sorted in descending order based on the total value of their respective bars.
The vertical axis range extends from 0 to 80, not 0 to 70.

errors.text_span: Стойностите са етикетирани с интервали от 5
errors.evidence: The labels on the vertical axis are at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, etc.), not 5.
The final label on the vertical axis is 80, not 70.

errors.text_span: "2. Въвеждане на цифрови технологии", "3. Цифрово общество"
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the categories from the legend. Category 2 is "Свързаност" (Connectivity), not "Въвеждане на цифрови технологии". Category 3 is "Внедряване на цифрови технологии" (Integration of digital technology), not "Цифрово общество". The term "Цифрово общество" is not present in the legend at all.

errors.text_span: Височината на всеки стълб отразява стойността на всяка съответна категория за дадената държава.
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect description of a stacked bar chart. The total height of each bar represents the sum of all categories, while the height of each colored segment within a bar represents the value for a single category.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени в порядку на височината, като най-високият стълб показва най-високата стойност за съответната категория.
errors.evidence: The claim that the highest bar shows the highest value for 'the corresponding category' is incorrect. The highest bar indicates the highest total score (sum of all categories), not necessarily the highest value in any single category.
The description fails to mention that the bar for Bulgaria (BG) is visually highlighted with a blue rectangle.
